invariants.rationale: Since the method returns null if b.doubleValue() is 0.0, any return must have b.doubleValue() != 0.0.

meta.value: method returns null if b is zero, so at exit b is not zero

invariants.rationale: The result is null if and only if b.doubleValue() is zero.

meta.value: method returns null only when b is zero

invariants.expression: result == null || (a instanceof Integer && result instanceof Integer) || (a instanceof Double && result instanceof Double)
invariants.rationale: Result is null or result is Integer or Double according to a's type.

meta.value: result is null or matches type of a

invariants.expression: result == null || (a instanceof Integer && ((Integer)result).intValue() == a.intValue() / b.intValue())
invariants.rationale: For Integer a, result equals integer division a/b.

meta.value: For Integer types, result equals a/b

invariants.expression: result == null || (a instanceof Double && ((Double)result).doubleValue() == a.doubleValue() / b.doubleValue())
invariants.rationale: For Double a, result equals double division a/b.

meta.value: For Double types, result equals a/b
